initial.text: Atlas API: after a rolling update, new pods are repeatedly OOMKilled; old pods remain Ready. Cause unknown.

inspect_rollout.text: Atlas API public Service atlas-api, namespace atlas-demo; old revision r17 and new revision r18. Four old and two new ready pods. New pods report OOMKilled, limit 512 MiB. Nodes have no MemoryPressure.

inspect_configuration.text: Effective RESULT_BUFFER_MIB changed from 64 on r17 to 256 on r18. The deployment changed this setting during the rollout.

inspect_routes.text: The public atlas-api Service selects app=atlas-api. EndpointSlices include all six ready pods from both revisions.

inspect_memory.text: At matched 70 requests/s, payload size, inflight requests and dependency latency: r17 peaks at 240 MiB; r18 reaches 512 MiB. Allocation traces attribute the increase to result buffers. Retained growth over time has not been measured.
